newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's knows of no reason for stock rise.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's knows of no reason for stock rise.

text.p: McDonald's Corp knows of no reason for the rise in its stock, which gained 1-3/4 at 46-3/8 on Friday afternoon, according to spokesman Chuck Ebeling.
Analysts also said they were unaware of any fundamental reason for the strength in McDonald's stock, other than a rise in the share price of other consumer companies.
"Consumer stocks are up in general," said Schroder Wertheim analyst Wayne Daniels.
Since the first quarter of 1996, McDonald's shares have declined from a high of over $54, and have recently been trading around $44 a share, analysts said.
"McDonald's has gotten to a discount to the market for the first time in quite some time," Daniels said. "It might be due for a little recovery."
